title: Courts of New Zealand case page (courtsofnz.govt.nz/cases/<slug>)

recognise.template: <main> with <h1 class=case__title> 'Name - [citation] or case number' and <h2> headings: Decision, Date of Judgment, Summary, Result, Media releases, Date of Hearing, Judges, Case Synopses, Submissions from counsel, Hearing Transcripts, Related Documents; the court in the breadcrumb

signals.measured_on: 2686 files recognised as courts-case-page among the corpus's 5,611 records, pages 1 and 2, 30 October 2026 (registers/courts, courts-2)

ocr: page-reader (GLM-OCR) for a page with no text layer, under profile courts-scanned-document, then recognised again from that text (ruling 128)
prompt: Read by the text reader (registers.courts.model_read, Flash-Next, profile text-reader): every person and body the document names with its role, counsel for each party, a one-line summary; the prompt is the module's PROMPT, its hash in the reading's settings; the deterministic reader takes the court, the case name, the citation, the dates, the result and every linked file (case_links)
notes: Crawl noise under the same MCP kind (a page's ++resource++ stylesheet, its sendto_form) is HTML with no <main> or no case title: set aside at recognise. The record's `date` is the fetch day and its `court` is blank; the page carries both.
